confidence_notes: FX: I ran one web search. It reported the RBA's 18 Nov 2026 4pm AUD/USD rate as 0.6720, but that figure came through a search summary and a third-party aggregator. I did not read the rba.gov.au table directly. Food and drink: three web searches were allowed and I used two. Aggregated cost-of-living sites put a budget meal at about $2 (citycost, Oct 2026), a cappuccino at $1.6-2.0, a local beer at $1.5-2.1 and a mid-range dinner for two at about $19. I moved meal and coffee figures up a little to reflect tourist-area restaurants. Beer is a restaurant serving; draft is uncommon in Udaipur, so this mostly reflects a large bottle. The cocktail figure comes partly from an old Expatistan club figure (about Rs954, Jan 2024) and is set lower for typical restaurants and bars. I found no Udaipur wine-by-the-glass price, so wine is estimated from the cocktail and beer price relationship and Indian-wine pricing. Wine is the least certain drink anchor. Accommodation: these are model estimates from general knowledge only, not live listings. They reflect July monsoon low season, when room rates in this popular tourist city are lower.
comparable_city_reasoning: Compared with Jaipur and Jodhpur, which are other Rajasthan tourist cities. Udaipur's lake-area tourist zone runs a little above the general Indian cost-of-living averages for food and drink.
